tools.name: fetch_llms_index
tools.description: Return the curated llms.txt index for stripe.dev. Useful as a site map / table of contents for an LLM.

tools.name: list_developer_events
tools.description: Return the full markdown listing of upcoming and past Stripe developer events, meetups, and workshops.

tools.name: list_recent_blog_posts
tools.description: List recent posts from the stripe.dev developer blog. Each result includes the title, slug, full URL, date, and topic tags.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return.

tools.name: open_blog_post
tools.description: Navigate the current browser tab to a stripe.dev blog post by its slug.

slug.description: The slug of the blog post (no extension). Usually kebab-case; a few legacy posts contain capital letters.
